svg.title: Simrule solution architecture
svg.desc: Swimlane diagram. An insurer submits a decline rule. AI services parse it, check scope and completeness, extract fields, assess 15 criteria with retrieval over a versioned knowledge base, find similar precedents, and deterministic code computes an advisory recommendation. Human reviewers confirm the extraction, validate or override each finding, obtain senior sign-off when required, and own the decision and rationale. Every action goes to an audit trail; decisions become precedents that feed similarity search and consistency monitoring. A chatbot answers insurers and reviewers from the same knowledge base.
svg.text: Simrule: AI-assisted review of auto insurance decline rules
Solution architecture. The AI advises; people decide; every step is recorded. Numbers follow the review flow.

g.text: Every action: time, person, role, before
and after, reason. Markdown or JSON export.

svg.text: AI component (advisory): shows Prototype and Production
Deterministic code (same in prototype and production)
Human touchpoint: a person validates, overrides or approves
Accountability control: version stamps, override reasons, sign-off,
ownership, audit trail, verified citations, bias and drift monitoring

Academic prototype for Ivey Online coursework. Not affiliated with or representative of the Financial Services Regulatory Authority of Ontario (FSRA). All insurer submissions and precedent records are fictional.
